title: ExternalDNS
description: Publishes DNS records for Gateway API and Service resources to an external DNS provider.

global.title: Global values
global.description: Helm global values (injected when used as a subchart).

external-dns.title: ExternalDNS settings
external-dns.description: Settings for the upstream external-dns chart. These are the upstream chart's own value names: Helm requires subchart values to live under a key named after the subchart and cannot compute them at render time, so a curated surface at the top level would be silently ignored.

name.title: Provider name
name.description: Which external DNS provider to publish to.

domainFilters.title: Managed zones
domainFilters.description: Only these DNS zones may be modified. An empty list allows every zone the credential can reach, which is strongly discouraged on a shared account.

policy.title: Record policy
policy.description: sync creates AND deletes records to match cluster state, so records are removed when their Service or Gateway is deleted - including on a cluster teardown. upsert-only never deletes.

sources.title: Watched sources
sources.description: Kubernetes resources to derive DNS records from. gateway-httproute is required for a Gateway API edge.

txtOwnerId.title: Owner ID
txtOwnerId.description: Identifier written into ownership TXT records. Must be unique per cluster when several clusters share a DNS zone, otherwise they will fight over the same records.

env.title: Provider credential
env.description: The provider API token, supplied as an environment variable sourced from an existing Secret. For Cloudflare the variable must be named CF_API_TOKEN. The Secret is placed out-of-band and is never part of this blueprint.
